info.title: Onix.Vault API
info.description:
Auditable vaults for real-world assets. Create a vault from items a custodian holds (custody derived per vault, the creator paid on chain), trade its token on a Meteora curve and, after graduation, on the pool; play for the items (USDC to custody: 93% stays in the treasury, 5% goes to the creator, 2% to Onix; a burned token shrinks supply); integrate a gacha through reservations. Every state change is anchored to a public transaction: payments are read from the chain before anything leaves custody. The server never holds a user's key and never signs a user's transaction. There is no API key: an integrator names itself in `integrator` on a reservation; limits are per address.

**1.4.0 (4 Oct 2026, security review):** every route that moves value answers `503` while the operator has paused the server or that vault (`GET /v1/health` → `paused`); every route that signs, settles or reads the chain on demand is rate-fenced per address (`429`); an unexpected error answers a generic `500` with a `ref` (never RPC or database text); addresses must be base58 public keys and signatures base58 text (`400`); `slippageBps` is an integer from 1 to 500; a reservation or a play is reached only through its own vault; an `Idempotency-Key` replays only for the same vault and integrator (`409` otherwise); an admission shows its value only once admitted, read from the chain. See `docs/security-review.md`.

**1.5.0:** the first design's redemption door is gone from the contract: no `redemptions` route, no `band` in `stats`, no `redeemPriceUsd` on items. The exit by burning is Play in tokens (`/play`, `/plays`), priced in share of backing.

**1.5.1:** the contract is served by the server itself at `GET /v1/openapi.json`.

**1.6.0 (11 Oct 2026):** every card a vault sells pays the creator 5% and Onix 2%; 93% stays in the treasury. Nothing changes on the wire: the buyer (a player, or an integrator through `reservations`) still pays the full price to the custody wallet, exactly as `paymentTransaction` builds it. The custody pays the two shares in its next fee claim (every 15 minutes, in the same transaction as the trading fees; `server/commissions.js`). The Activity rows of a USDC play and of a gacha sale carry `sale` (the split, its status and the payout signature); `fee-claims` carry `creatorUsd`, `salesOnixUsd`, `salesCount`; `stats.treasury` carries `owedUsd` and `availableUsd`; each vault in `GET /v1/vaults` carries `saleSplit`. Sales made before 11 Oct 2026 are `pre_rule` and owe nothing.

get.summary: This contract, as the running server holds it
What is configured (never a secret)
Every vault this server serves, each with its stats

saleSplit.description: where the price of every card sold goes, in percent

get.summary: Backing (index and realisable) and, when a pool exists, price · supply · market cap · graduation progress — read on the server
get.description: Backing and the pool are two numbers and are never summed; `pool.ratio` is the only place they meet. `pool` is null and `poolStatus` says why until the curve is launched.

get.summary: The doors that fired, newest first: gacha sales, plays, the creator’s additions, the treasury’s purchases and fee claims (with the sales they paid out), graduation — each with its signatures

reservationId.description: gacha rows: the reservation this sale settled

sale.description: USDC plays and gacha sales: where the price went (5% creator · 2% Onix · 93% treasury) and whether the custody paid the two shares yet. null for a token play, or a sale made before the rule (pre_rule rows are not joined). Absent on vaults without the ledger.

payoutId.description: the fee claim that carries the two legs

creatorUsd.description: fees rows: paid to the creator in this claim (the 5% of the sales)

salesOnixUsd.description: fees rows: the 2% of the sales, part of onixUsd

salesCount.description: fees rows: sales paid out in this claim

get.summary: What in a wallet could back a vault: items from a registered custodian with a value on chain; the rest listed with the reason

custodian.description: the registered custodian holding the item; null for a token nobody registered (its picture is never relayed)

imageUrl.description: only for an item from a registered custodian

get.summary: Every priced item in the vault wallet, read from the chain

post.summary: Reserve an item for a draw; returns the payment transaction to sign
post.description: Reserve only when your player has already paid you. The exit price is frozen for the reservation window. The response carries `paymentTransaction` (base64, unsigned, single signer = `integrator`, memo = reservation id): sign it, send it, then settle. Honours `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: replays the same reservation for the same vault and integrator; a key already used by another integrator or vault answers 409

integrator.description: the wallet that will pay — a base58 Solana address

winner.description: the wallet that receives the item — a base58 Solana address

post.summary: Prove the payment landed; the vault delivers
post.description: The vault reads the transaction from the chain and checks: finalized; credits the vault's USDC account with at least the frozen price; memo equals the reservation id. Only then it builds the delivery to `winner`, asserts it has a single unsigned signer (the vault), SIMULATES it, signs, persists the signed transaction and broadcasts. A payment signature settles one reservation, ever. `paymentSignature` must be base58 text (400 otherwise, before the chain is asked). A reservation of another vault answers 404.

402.description: payment does not cover the reservation

409.description: not found / not finalized yet / already used — retry later

410.description: reservation expired; refunds are manual in v1

503.description: paid, but the delivery failed (it is simulated before it is signed; a delivery that would fail on chain is never broadcast). The reservation is `delivery_failed`, keeps the payment, and the operator re-runs the delivery by hand (`scripts/retry-delivery.js`); poll `GET …/reservations/{id}` for `deliverySignature`.

What a wallet could open a vault on, and the curve those rules imply

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: JSON of the creator's rules (category, minValueUsd, minGrade, creatorFeePct, gradMult); off-list values are 422

post.summary: The coin image or the banner: raw bytes, typed by the bytes (PNG, JPEG, WebP — never SVG), up to 1 MB, stored under its sha256

201.description: uploadId, type, bytes, url (a preview at GET /v1/vaults/create/uploads/{id}); orphans are swept after an hour

get.summary: Preview of an upload before launch (fixed Content-Type, nosniff)

post.summary: Step 1 — open a creation: the custody wallet is derived and the deposit transactions (items + gas → custody) are built for the creator to sign. Nothing of Onix is spent.

201.description: creationId, custodyWallet, depositTransactions[] (base64, unsigned, single signer = owner), gasSol, items, backing, expiresAt

409.description: a creation already in flight for this wallet, or the symbol is taken

post.summary: Step 2 — the chain shows every item (and the gas) in custody → Onix creates the curve config (simulated first; paid once) → the launch transaction is built for the creator

200.description: creationId, pool, baseMint, config, curve, backing, transaction (base64, UNSIGNED), message

409.description: custody does not hold the items yet / no gas / the program would refuse the config

post.summary: Step 3 — the creator signed the launch (signTransaction): same content as built (wallet wrappers ignored) → the mint key completes it → broadcast

409.description: not the transaction that was built, or the creator did not sign

post.summary: Step 4 — the pool is on chain → the vault is registered (custody, creator, rules, manifest, image, banner) and served at once
Before launch: custody returns every item and the gas to the creator (signed by the derived key); strangers cannot

get.summary: Where a creation stands; while open, what custody still lacks and fresh deposit transactions for exactly that

200.description: status, symbol, mints, custodyWallet, missingMints, custodySol, depositTransactions?

get.summary: Token metadata of a created vault (what wallets, Jupiter and Meteora read): name, symbol, description, image, banner, external_url
The coin image (and /token/{mint}-banner.png the banner): fixed Content-Type from the bytes, nosniff, cached a day

The machines: open (Play opens at graduation) and the bands by custodian value with items, odds, priceUsdc (avg × 1.15) and priceTokens (avg × 1.10 ÷ backing per token — share of backing, never the market price)

200.description: open, lockedReason, currencies{usdc, token}, tokenSymbol, bands[{id, label, items, kind: draw|pick|empty, avgIndexUsd, priceUsdc, priceTokens, odds, preview[]}], navPerTokenUsd

post.summary: Open a play: the commit (sha256 of the server seed) is published and the payment transaction is built for the player — USDC to custody + memo play:<id>, or a burnChecked of the player's own vault tokens + memo. Unsigned, single signer, simulated first.

201.description: playId, serverSeedHash, band, items, odds, currency, price, unit, memo, paymentTransaction (base64), quoteValidUntil, expiresAt

402.description: the wallet lacks the funds — nothing was sent

409.description: Play not open yet (the vault has not graduated), an unpaid play waiting, or token plays closed

get.summary: Plays of this vault (paid ones), newest first

post.summary: The player paid: the signature is recorded (UNIQUE). A sweep waits for finality, reads the payment from the transaction itself, draws, holds the item and delivers from custody.

409.description: already paid / this signature already paid a play

post.description: `signature` must be base58 text (400 otherwise). A play of another vault answers 404.

get.summary: The proof: status, commit, server seed (once done), client seed, nonce, digest, index, snapshot (mints sorted), payment and delivery signatures

post.summary: Quote a buy (USDC → token) or sell (token → USDC) on the live pool
post.description: Meteora DBC quote on the current pool state. 409 until the token launches. One door for the token's whole life: while the curve is live the quote is Meteora DBC's (buys fill up to the graduation threshold and return the rest: amountInUsed, amountInLeft, partial); once migrated the same route trades on the graduated DAMM v2 pool (quote.venue = 'pool', priceImpactPct). The server never signs; the transaction is simulated first (402 with the two numbers when the wallet lacks funds).

amount.description: USDC for buy, tokens for sell

slippageBps.description: how far the price may move before the transaction fails; 1–500 bps

post.summary: Build the swap for the user's wallet to sign — unsigned, single signer = owner, nothing pre-signed
post.description: Returns the base64 transaction and the base58 message Phantom's signAndSendTransaction takes. The server never signs trades. One door for the token's whole life: while the curve is live the quote is Meteora DBC's (buys fill up to the graduation threshold and return the rest: amountInUsed, amountInLeft, partial); once migrated the same route trades on the graduated DAMM v2 pool (quote.venue = 'pool', priceImpactPct). The server never signs; the transaction is simulated first (402 with the two numbers when the wallet lacks funds).

slippageBps.description: how far the price may move before the transaction fails; 1–500 bps

get.summary: USDC and vault token held by a wallet (what the panel shows as balance and Max)
What in a wallet passes THIS vault's rules (custodian, category, minimum value); the rest with the reason

post.summary: Build the transfer of an eligible item from the owner to the vault — unsigned, single signer = owner
post.description: Only the vault's creator, and only an item the creator holds that passes the vault's rules (403 / 404 / 422 otherwise). The answer is the unsigned transfer into custody, single signer = the creator, with the item's custodian value and realisable value. No tokens are owed for an admission: the creator is paid by the 50% allocation, the fee share and 5% of every card sold.

200.description: the unsigned transfer, with the item's value and realisable value

post.summary: Record a sent admission (the signature of the transfer); verified against the chain within a minute
post.description: `mint` and `owner` must be base58 addresses and `signature` base58 text. The admission is admitted only when custody holds the item and the named transfer was signed by the creator; its value is then read from the item (the one sent is never shown); a transfer signed by anyone else is rejected; nothing after an hour expires.

get.summary: Every admission with its signature and status (pending | admitted)
get.description: Lists pending and admitted admissions; `valueUsd` is null until admitted.

get.summary: Trading fees claimed into the treasury (curve partner fee split 2/3 treasury · 1/3 Onix in the same tx; pool LP fee 100% treasury) and, in the same transaction, the sales paid out: 5% of every card sold to the creator, 2% to Onix

200.description: claims[]: curveUsd, poolUsd, onixUsd (Onix’s third of the curve fee + its 2% of the sales), treasuryUsd (the custody’s net move; negative when only sales were paid), creatorUsd, salesOnixUsd, salesCount, creatorWallet, solSpentLamports, status, signature, at

get.summary: Items the treasury bought (the restock bot, under the vault's rules)

200.description: purchases[]: mint, name, priceUsd, insuredUsd, venue, status, signature, at

Paused.description: paused for maintenance — nothing is lost; try again later

TooMany.description: rate limit for this address on this kind of request; try again later

paused.description: The emergency stop: while `global` is true, or the vault is listed, every route that moves value answers 503. Nothing is lost; payments already made are processed when it lifts.

vaults.description: vault ids or wallets paused one by one

ref.description: only on 500: a reference the operator finds in the server log (the error text itself never leaves the server)

treasury.description: USDC in the custody wallet right now (never part of backing)

owedUsd.description: of it, what the cards sold owe the creator and Onix until the next fee claim pays it

availableUsd.description: usdc − owedUsd: what the treasury may spend on the next item
